title: CyrusOne, LLC.
description:
Update 23 Aug : We are removing the clients name off this post. They are refusing to pay a $13 million demand. They have 24 hours left to engage with us. We hold 12.9 million Salesforce records along with: Sharepoint:
(369.6 GB Compressed / 645 GB Uncompressed)
288,729 Files, 60,513 Folders

Make the right decision, don't be the next headline. | Updated: 23 Aug 2026 | Warning: FINAL WARNING PAY OR LEAK
